subject: Social Media
title: Notification Hijacking
description: A micro-lesson that makes Notification Hijacking usable.

hook.text: That red badge on your app icon. You see it and feel urgency. Nothing is urgent. But you check anyway.

buildup.text: Notifications exploit the orienting response—your brain's ancient reflex to notice sudden changes.

discovery.text: Apps batch notifications to maximize interruption. They don't alert you instantly—they wait for peak impact.

twist.text: Every notification interruption costs 23 minutes of refocused attention. The cost is invisible but enormous.

climax.text: Turning off notifications feels uncomfortable. That discomfort proves how deep the conditioning goes.

punchline.text: The red dot owns a piece of your attention.

quiz.question: How long does it take to refocus after a notification interruption?
